title: Local Zero IPC contract (system <-> brain)
description: Newline-delimited JSON over a Windows named pipe. One JSON object per line, UTF-8, no BOM. This file is the single source of truth for the C# system layer and the Python brain layer. Changing it is a standalone commit and requires human approval. See docs/CONTRACTS.md.

protocolVersion.description: Contract major version. A receiver MUST drop any message whose v it does not implement.

messageId.description: UUIDv4 assigned by the sender. Unique per message, used to correlate errors.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, millisecond precision, always ending in Z.

nullableNumber.description: A measured value, or null when the sensor is unavailable. null means UNAVAILABLE and is rendered as a labelled gap. It is never rendered as zero, never interpolated, never inferred from load. See docs/SECURITY.md and CLAUDE.md invariant 10.

nullableInteger.description: As nullableNumber, for integral quantities such as byte counts.

percent.description: A percentage in [0, 100], or null when unavailable.

sensorCapability.description: Declares, once at connect time, whether a telemetry field will ever carry a value on this machine. The UI builds its labelled gaps from this, so it never has to guess why a field is null.

field.description: Dotted path into telemetry.sample payload, e.g. 'cpu.temperature_c'.

source.description: How the value is obtained. 'pdh_english' is the only permitted performance-counter source; localized counter lookup is forbidden. See CLAUDE.md invariant 9.

unavailable_reason.description: Required and non-null when available is false. Shown verbatim to the user, e.g. 'requires kernel driver - not installed'.

helloMessage.description: system -> brain. First message on every new pipe connection. The brain MUST NOT accept telemetry before a valid hello.

app_version.description: Semantic version of the C# sidecar binary.

elevated.description: MUST be false. Local Zero runs every process asInvoker; a true value here is a contract violation and the brain MUST refuse the connection. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md privilege model.

poll_interval_ms.description: Interval at which the sidecar will emit telemetry.sample.

sensors.description: Complete capability descriptor. Every field the UI can display appears here exactly once, available or not.

telemetrySampleMessage.description: system -> brain. One reading of the machine. Emitted on the sidecar's own tick; the brain never polls.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing per connection, starting at 0. A gap tells the consumer samples were dropped.

temperature_c.description: Expected to be null on this machine: no ring-0 driver, so no CPU temperature source exists. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sensor strategy.

utilization_percent.description: Sum over GPU Engine instances, clamped to 100. Measured readable unelevated on this machine.

temperature_c.description: Null until the AMD ADLX spike resolves. See docs/ROADMAP.md M5 and the U1 open question.

errorMessage.description: Either direction. Reports a fault without terminating the connection. The message field is user-safe prose; detail is for the log. Neither may contain a secret, a full filesystem path outside allowed roots, or a stack trace.

in_reply_to.description: id of the offending message when one exists, otherwise null.
